checks: Capabilities explicitly identify the independent CPU engine and unsupported GPU/Qwen3.8/API paths
Independent loader validates the actual committed GGUF and reports inspection without compute
Actual MoE CPU generation produces complete output and distinguishes output tokens from decode steps
Standard-input Unicode prompt uses the complete reversible byte tokenizer
CPU execution requires explicit selection and never silently falls back to Strata
Prompt plus requested output must fit the configured context before generation
Empty prompts and zero output reservations are rejected
Qwen3.8-style architecture metadata is explicitly rejected rather than relabeled as supported
Truncated GGUF tensor payload is rejected by the independent loader
Four independent CPU sequences execute within two worker threads with reproducible token checksums
Benchmark excludes warmup/load/tokenization and derives rates from paired measured durations and executed steps
Saved benchmark JSON exactly matches the reported samples
Invalid concurrency and warmup settings fail explicitly
Benchmark report output equal to the input checkpoint is rejected with all model bytes preserved
Benchmark report output hard-linked to the input checkpoint is rejected without modifying either path
Forge9070 engine subcommand selects the independent engine and executes generation
scope: Actual standalone CPU CLI and synthetic-model execution; not HTTP, GPU or pretrained-model quality
